title: Test composed requirements beyond isolated contract passes
body: Operator selected measurements of existing KRN mechanisms, not adoption based on research alone. Source: .krn/runs/rss-research/reports/Mechaniki zwiększające skuteczność KRN.md. All proposed effects remain unmeasured in KRN. No external service, production, credential or global policy mutation is granted by this task. Pre-register the bounded pilot and independent oracle before running it.

Outcome: detect failures that appear only when independently passing requirements are combined.
Reuse the continuation pilot and its preregistered oracle. Choose a bounded pairwise/composed set, including large capsule + Unicode + resume, then missing/stale metadata or interrupted writes where applicable. Prove the individual controls pass on the same pinned candidate before measuring combinations. Record which interaction fails and the actual receiver state, with zero invented permissions or acceptance. Avoid duplicating the first twelve cases; extend to other observed KRN contracts only when justified. Do not infer KRN success from SpecBench or build an exhaustive combinatorial framework before the small pilot.
